A workflow named rich-revision using mock/echo. Declare region as a string input defaulting to eu-west and verbose as an optional bool input. Declare the constants window_hours 48, label it's late and limits as an integer typed constant of 3. Grant the nika:log and nika:write tools and the echo command, and run with no entropy. A fetch task runs echo with the argument [1, 2, 3], retried up to 3 attempts with a 250 ms backoff and no jitter, under a 30s timeout, and extracts count as the length of its output. Only when fetch fails and inputs.verbose == true, a report task in the reports group logs at info level, for each of the items a and b with at most 2 in parallel and without failing fast, the window in hours, the limit, the region and the item, recovering with none on error. Once report has settled, a persist task binds the label and writes it to out/report.md, overwriting it. Expose total as the fetch count.
